scientific_role: targeted confirmation of the inconclusive BTS-100K system-overhead unit

trigger.reason: The original formal matrix failed only the BTS-100K direct-layer position-stability gate.

design.ordering: two complete cycles of all 24 four-layer permutations
design.purpose: exactly balance execution position and immediate predecessor effects

decision_policy: The original formal failure remains permanently retained.
A confirmation PASS authorizes BTS-100K evidence only when combined with the three originally passed units.
A confirmation FAIL leaves BTS-100K inconclusive and does not invalidate the other three passed units.
No threshold may be changed after observing the confirmation measurements.
The optimizer is neither refitted nor reevaluated in this confirmation.
